contentType.name: ITP
contentType.description: Generated Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) deliverable subtype. Inherits all Generated Deliverable columns (DocumentStatus defaults to Draft, DraftMarker 'DRAFT — pending engineering review'). Supports the user capability 'generate ITPs'. ITP line items live in the Dataverse ITP register (schemas/dataverse/itp-register.json), referenced by ItpRegisterId. Mirrors information-architecture.md section 4.5.

columnOverrides.description: Fixed to itp for this subtype.

columns.name: ItpRegisterId
columns.description: Foreign key to the Dataverse ITP register header row holding the structured line items.

columns.name: ScopeOfWork
columns.description: Scope of work the ITP covers.
